free_text: Given the prior positive biopsy confirming ISUP grade group 3 malignancy, the question shifts to whether the current findings warrant re-evaluation for progression. The PI-RADS 5 lesion and the current PSA of 9.3 ng/mL are significant factors. The evidence strongly supports a biopsy to re-evaluate the known lesion and assess for progression, overriding the deferral criteria.
